description: Combined least-privilege IAM policy overview for Redacted. Individual role trust, execution, caller, and S3 bucket policies are stored alongside this file in infrastructure/.

guarantees: No S3 read/write/delete permissions (explicit Deny on s3:*)
Scoped to Bedrock InvokeModel/ApplyGuardrail, redacted-harness-hook Lambda, and CloudWatch/X-Ray telemetry
InvokeHarness scoped to specific Redacted Harness ARN
Read-only s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on documents/*
Explicit Deny on s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, and direct runtime shell execution
Read-only S3 access to documents/* with TLS enforcement
Explicit Deny on writes, deletes, and Harness Execution Role direct S3 access
